senses.gloss: m. (חָמַם) vessel for heating water, boiler for mixing wine.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:5">Sabb. III, 5</cite> <he>המ׳ שפינהו וכ׳</he>, expl.

<cite ref="Shabbat 41a">ib. 41ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>המ׳ שפינה ממנו מים חמין</he> a boiler which was emptied of its hot water; (oth. explan.) <he>המ׳ שפינהו וכ׳</he> a boiler which has been removed from the stove; Y. ib. III, beg. 5ᶜ <he>העביר את המ׳</he> when he has removed the boiler.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:13">Pes. VII, 13</cite> <he>המ׳ באמצע</he> the boiler for mixing the wine is placed between the two parties.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:1">Kel. XIV, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 1</cite> <he>המ׳ כדי לקבל סלעין</he> a boiler (when defective) is susceptible of uncleanness as long as it can be used for keeping coins in it; a. fr.
